subject: info-af-b
title: INFO.AF.B.------CR.INFO.DY.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-35, second of two on book p179. (C)INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is the subject. The main line runs from the subject to C-CONT (composite continuance). CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) and CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) branch from the main line. CRTF-D carries APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) and STF (source transfer); MT-INFO (multi-information) branches from STF, COS-D (cosmic dictates) from MT-INFO, ALT-F (alternative functionalism) from COS-D, and LANG-DY (language dynamics) from ALT-F. CR-INFO-DY carries CUL-TF-S (cultural transfer shifts) and CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis).
